3b.note: d=7 confirmed. Enumerating ALL tie-break orders: exact code obtainable for d=7 only (within d<=7) and not for d=1..6. d=5 and d=6 give an optimal-cost code of that shape (cost 55, 57 = Huffman cost) but no tie-break of Huffman builds it (c and d are the two smallest after b+a merge). With left<=right, d<=7, so d=7 is the only value, consistent with the tie ruling. Without the convention d=8..12 would also be buildable.
